summary: Today’s pulse tracks Residents warned to brace for the worst as Canada wildfire rages out of control, Middle East crisis live: Netanyahu rejects Trump’s Gaza plan and vows no withdrawal until Hamas disarms, and Parents of baby girl killed at nursery fear unsafe sleeping ‘rife’ across England. Across BBC, Guardian, and NPR, the strongest repeated signals are trump, hamas, and attack. In the background, Haunted by Hoover, Trump searches for an endgame in Iran and Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan returning to Ireland in high-security operation keep the wider picture in motion.

headlines.title: Residents warned to brace for the worst as Canada wildfire rages out of control
headlines.description: The Bald Range wildfire in British Columbia, still considered "out of control", has spread over more than 39 sq miles (103 sq km).

headlines.title: Middle East crisis live: Netanyahu rejects Trump’s Gaza plan and vows no withdrawal until Hamas disarms
headlines.description: Israeli prime minister says he will not support 15-point plan hailed by Donald Trump The US plan that would see Hamas disarmed and Israeli withdrawal from Gaza was announced at the end of July. Here’s a recap of the details of that plan from when it was announced: Announcing the agreement in a social media post, Trump said it involved the “complete disarmament” of Hamas and other armed groups in Gaza and was “a monumental step toward ending the fighting”. Israel has pointed to Hamas’s failure to disarm as justification for its continued strikes and refusal to allow any reconstruction in Gaza, and for Israeli forces’ steady edging forward from the demarcation line agreed in October.

headlines.title: Parents of baby girl killed at nursery fear unsafe sleeping ‘rife’ across England
headlines.description: Katie and John Meehan say responses to campaign they launched after death of daughter Genevieve must be ‘wake-up call’ The parents of a nine-month-old girl who died after being placed in an unsafe sleeping position at nursery said they feared poor practice may be “rife” across England. Genevieve Meehan suffocated when she was strapped face down to a beanbag for an hour and 37 minutes at a nursery in Cheadle Hulme, Stockport, in May 2022.

headlines.title: Haunted by Hoover, Trump searches for an endgame in Iran
headlines.description: President Trump is confronting a question that has haunted presidents throughout history: how a war - that has gone on longer than predicted - can reshape a presidency.

headlines.title: Suspected crime boss Daniel Kinahan returning to Ireland in high-security operation
headlines.description: The Irish Prison Service bought a bulletproof and bombproof van to transport the 49-year-old to court after his extradition from Dubai.

headlines.title: Yemen’s Houthis claim responsibility for attack on Saudi oil refinery
headlines.description: Drone strike comes after Riyadh signs defence pact and Iran issues tough demands to reopen strait of Hormuz Middle East crisis live – latest updates Yemen’s Tehran-aligned Houthis have claimed responsibility for an attack on a refinery in Saudi Arabia, two days after the kingdom signed ⁠a defence pact with Turkey ⁠and Pakistan in response to ​growing regional instability caused by the US-Israel war on Iran. The attack early on Sunday came after Iran issued tough new demands to reopen the strait of Hormuz , and the United Arab Emirates said one of its ships had been targeted by an Iranian missile, as a deal to open the strategic waterway remained out of reach.

headlinePool.description: Italy's culture minister says it is one of the most important underwater archaeological finds in years.

headlinePool.title: Israel rejects Trump's 15-point plan for Gaza, Netanyahu says
headlinePool.description: Israel's PM says its military will not pull-out from Gaza until Hamas is "genuinely" disarmed.

headlinePool.title: Top Democrats simulate election threats as Trump continues assault on voting
headlinePool.description: Chuck Schumer and other senators took part in exercises in which legal experts laid out election disruption scenarios In a Washington DC conference room last month, some of the most senior Democrats in the US Senate gathered to plan for a prospect that only recently would have felt more attune to science fiction: they started to wargame democracy. Chuck Schumer, the US Senate minority leader, and senators including Alex Padilla, Adam Schiff, Mark Warner, Elissa Slotkin and Raphael Warnock were among those in the room as a team of legal experts offered scenarios.

headlinePool.title: This rising painter reimagines Renaissance art in a cocoa plantation in Cameroon
headlinePool.description: A new gallery show in London features the paintings of Marc Padeu, playing with themes from Renaissance art and bringing them to his homeland of Cameroon.

headlinePool.title: Body of woman found in suitcase by side of road in regional NSW
headlinePool.description: Police called to Oallen, about 40km south of Goulburn, on Sunday afternoon after suitcase discovered near Wolgon Road NSW police said they were called to Wolgon Road, near Oallen Ford Road, in Oallen at about 12.50pm on Sunday “following reports a body had been located”.

headlinePool.title: Press access spat adds to fears of circus around Luigi Mangione murder trial
headlinePool.description: Lawyers for man accused of killing healthcare CEO Brian Thompson raise red flags about limits on reporters Weeks before Luigi Mangione faces a jury over the killing of the UnitedHealthcare executive Brian Thompson, the hugely anticipated proceedings already have potential to reach trial-of-the-century status. Intense global interest in Mangione’s case is unfolding against a media landscape where news consumers expect minute-by-minute updates, a mise-en-scène now made all the more complicated by social media influencers who managed to get press credentials and often flock to major US criminal cases in search of clicks and money.

headlinePool.title: Mount Toba eruption doesn't seem like it could nearly kill our species
headlinePool.description: The massive Toba eruption seems to have had little climate impact.

headlinePool.title: Andy Burnham to tour Britain in effort to reconnect government with public
headlinePool.description: PM expected to announce policies to tackle cost of living and indicate intent to help improve country’s high streets Andy Burnham is to undertake a national tour this coming week as he aims to improve the government’s connection with the British public during his premiership. The prime minister is expected to announce a set of policies that will help people financially as many struggle with the cost of living , as well as indicate his intent to improve high streets across the country.

headlinePool.title: Yemen's Houthis claim attack on Aramco oil facility in Saudi Arabia, and other Middle East news
headlinePool.description: Meanwhile, Iran has made new demands about the restart of negotiations and the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz, and the Pentagon is pressing the U.S. defense industry to accelerate production of weapons.
